agency: Store/branch list: repeats its children per agency from specials.agencies or datagrid specials.datagrid_id; children use {{agency_name}}/{{agency_address}}…; googleTarget = googlemap id to pan.
attr: Product variation picker (product page; or inside bonus-items). specials.attrName = attribute or 'auto' (+autoNamePriority); specials.layout 1 list, 2 select, 3 photo+name, 4 custom list.
auto-number: Ticking counter: from specials.startNumber toward endNumber, adding a random 0..jumpNumber step every specials.duration seconds. Leaf; no children.
blog-overlay: Hover overlay inside each grid-blog/slider-blog card. Rendered only when specials.type is 'blog-overlay' (the editor's value); other values are dropped.
bonus-items: Repeats its children per bonus item of the viewed product; specials.typeBonus: promotion (gifts, default) | bonus_product | combo_product. Children: text-dataset, image-dataset, attr, checkbox-item.
button-login-facebook: 'Log in with Facebook' button (FB logo + specials.text). Sits in a login form; needs a click event with action login_facebook.
button-login-google: 'Sign in with Google' button (Google logo + specials.text). Sits in a login form; needs a click event with action login_google.
calendar: Calendar icon that opens a date picker (child calendar-content); 'Chọn' writes the date to form field specials.field_name (+ date/hours) of its form or bindings[0].target form.
calendar-content: The popup of a calendar: month grid + fixed hour slots + select button. Child of calendar only; its own children are not rendered.
cart-droppable: Mini-cart panel shown by cart-icon. Lives in the site's cart source, not a page section; specials.type 'data' (cart has items) or 'empty'. Renders its children.
cart-items-empty: Empty-cart state: shown in place of the line items when the cart is empty. Child of cart-items; children: text, image.
checkbox-group: Checkbox list FILTER (no form name): each specials.options[].filter filters the grid-product ids in filter_elements; is_auto_child_categories builds options from categories.
checkbox-item: Checkbox that selects the bonus/combo item it sits in. Child of bonus-items.
collapse-content: Body panel of an accordion: renders its children inside a collapse (whose specials.name is the header).
collapse-item: Not rendered by the published page — don't use.
color-group: Colour-swatch FILTER: specials.options [{color,name,filter}] filter the grid-product ids in filter_elements; specials.selectionMode many (default) | one.
country: Country <select> in a form: specials.countries [{country_code,country_name,phone_code}] (value = phone_code), default specials.defaultValue; sibling phone/postal fields then validate per country.
current-location: Not rendered by the published page — don't use.
current-password: Password input for the existing password (change-password form). Never pattern-validated; specials.showHidePassword adds an eye toggle. Sits in a form.
custom-layout: Extra-info template inside grid-product/slider-product cards, rendered only when the list's specials.plugins has store_show_extra_info; children bind to the product; {{promotion_*}} filled.
customer-address: Logged-in member's saved addresses: repeats its children per address. Children: text-dataset bound customer_address::* and buttons (set default / delete).
detect-address: Free-text address input with auto-completion (DetectAddress). Required unless specials.required is false. Sits in a form.
dropdown: specials.is_default_select true: native <select> of specials.options sorting/filtering the grid-product ids in filter_elements. Otherwise a click toggle that opens its dropdown-content child.
dropdown-content: The panel a dropdown opens. Child of dropdown; holds menu, checkbox-group, radio-group, two-point-range, container…
empty-product-layout: Shown instead of the cards when a grid-product/slider-product has no products (else a built-in 'Chưa có sản phẩm nào' block). Child of that list; children: text, image.
favorite-icon: Heart toggle that adds/removes the product to the wishlist. Needs a product context: inside a product card (grid-product layout, product-overlay) or product page.
flash-sale: Container for a flash-sale banner: hidden unless promotion specials.promotion_advance_id is running (and not sold out for the product). Children: text, countdown…
grid-blog: Grid of BLOG CATEGORIES (not articles): image, name, description, link. specials.showBlogs picks categories, else top-level ones; config.columns. Child blog-overlay = hover layer.
grid-category: Grid of product categories (image + name, links to category page). specials.showCategories picks them, else all top-level; config.columns per row.
group-select: Plain wrapper rendering its children side by side; the editor fills it with 3 select fields. Sits in a form.
id-number: Citizen ID number (CCCD) input field; sits directly in a form and is styled by the form like every field. specials.field_name names the submitted value.
identity: Login field accepting email OR phone (validated against both; phone rules from specials.validate_country, default 84). Sits in a login/register form.
input-date: Date/time picker input in a form: specials.type date|time, field_name, enableRange, startDay/endDay limits, use_option_time; field_connect_pos maps to a POS customer field.
input-file: File upload field in a form (dashed upload box). specials.allow_multiple (default true), allowed_file_types, isTransferImage; field_name is the submitted key.
input-number: Numeric input in a form; specials.startNumber/endNumber become min/max; field_name is the submitted key.
input-product-note: Text box (max 255) for a buyer's note on the product page; an add_to_cart event's link_product_note = this id sends it with the cart item.
input-search: Storefront search box: goes to the search page (specials.default_search_page search_page|category_page|blog_page). Child search-droppable shows live suggestions.
language-menu: Language/market switcher (flag, name, currency). specials.type dropdown|inline, show_flag. Renders nothing unless the site has multiple languages set up.
layout-dataset: Repeater chosen by bindings[0].name: purchase_history, customer_address, or data_custom (collection rows, {{field}} placeholders, display_count). Children: text-dataset, button.
lesson-items: Course lesson cards from the current module: specials.link 'next_lesson' (default) shows the next lesson only, otherwise all module lessons. Children: text-dataset bound to lesson fields.
lesson-sidebar: Course page sidebar listing the course's modules and lessons (open/checked state, click to switch lesson). Renders nothing if the course has no tracks.
list-courses: Logged-in member's purchased courses (my-courses API) with a 'View detail' button; specials.items_per_load + type_view_more (load more / pagination).
list-lesson-droppable: Panel opened by a video-dataset's lesson-list button (shown when the video's show_list_next_video_btn is on). Child of video-dataset; renders its children.
list-ordered: Logged-in member's order history table (customer/orders API). specials.tableItems = columns (id, full_name, invoice_value, status); items_per_load; type_view_more 2 = pagination.
lucky-wheel: Spin-to-win wheel: prizes from datagrid specials.datagrid_id (min 4 slices), spinCounter turns, spinMessage with {{name}}/{{coupon}}, popup_id_end / popup_id_turn popups.
masonry-review: Masonry wall of product reviews (photos/video, stars) with average summary, sort and write-review button. Product page: that product's reviews; else site-wide. specials.reviews_pre_load.
member-bar: Header account widget: logged out shows login/signup links (specials.loginPage/signupPage, or popups via event_type 'open_popup'); logged in shows avatar/name (layoutShow). Child: member-dropdown.
member-dropdown: Account dropdown panel of a member-bar, shown for a logged-in visitor. Sits only in member-bar; children: text/button/container (account links, logout). specials.dropdown_position left|right.
menu-anchor-item: Menu entry that scrolls to a section of the current page on click. Label specials.name, target specials.anchor. Sits in a menu.
menu-droppable: Off-canvas drawer of a hamburger menu, opened by the menu's toggle. Sits in a menu; children: menu, container, text, image, input-search… config.position left|right|top|bottom, specials.effect.
next-lesson-droppable: Next-lesson popup on a course video player's skip button. Rendered only as a direct child of video-dataset with specials.show_next_video_lesson on; children: lesson-items.
number-step: Row of price-range buttons splitting specials.minValue..maxValue into specials.count steps; specials.filter 'filter_price' filters the product list. specials.use_button_filter = apply on button.
order-history: Logged-in customer's order list (status, countdown, cancel/pay/repurchase buttons), loaded client-side; children are the empty state. Often in tabs. specials.items_per_load.
otp-input: OTP boxes (specials.otp_length, default 4) + 'get code' button sending a code to the form's phone/email (specials.field_binding). Sits in a form; submitted as specials.field_name (default 'otp').
otp-method: Radio list of OTP channels from specials.options (active ones only; none active = renders nothing). Sets the channel for its form, or page forms of type form_signup/form_order. specials.defaultValue.
password: Password field (type=password) in a form; name = specials.field_name. With required + specials.validate it enforces specials.validate_password regex; specials.showHidePassword adds an eye toggle.
paypal-button: PayPal checkout buttons: client loads the PayPal SDK with the site's PayPal client id. Sits in a form and validates it before paying. No settings.
post-list: Blog post grid of specials.category_id with pagination (numbers_posts_to_show_per_page). Card overlay = post-overlay child with specials.type 'post-overlay'. Sits in a section/container.
post-overlay: Overlay layer repeated on each card of a post-list/slider-post. Used only when specials.type is 'post-overlay' (new_element sets it; a legacy 'regular' one is ignored). Children: rectangle, container, button.
postal-code: Postal/ZIP input in a form; name = specials.field_name. With required + specials.validate it enforces the specials.postal_code regex (pattern deferred if the form has a country field).
product-gallery: Product-page media gallery: the current product's images/videos with thumbnail nav (specials.showNavigation), zoom (specials.zoom_type), autoplay. Sits in a section/container of a product page.
product-image-carousel: Product-page slider of every image and video across the current product's variations. specials.slideMode (default 'snap'). Empty outside a product page.
product-overlay: Overlay layer on each product card of grid-product/slider-product. specials.type: discount (only on discounted products), regular (every card), quick-view (replaces the quick-view button).
product-review: Current product's reviews: rating breakdown, filter/sort, paged list (specials.reviews_per_page, layout) and a write-review button opening a form. Use on a product page.
promotions: Repeats its children per promotion, filling {{promotion_name}}, {{promotion_code}}, {{promotion_value}}, {{promotion_end_date}}, {{promotion_image}}. specials.getBy all|product + displayPromotions.
promotions-short: Compact chips of promotion codes; click copies a coupon code (or runs its OpenPopup event). specials.getBy 'all' (kinds in specials.displayPromotions) or 'product' (current product's promotions).
question-container: Course lesson quiz: clones its template children (text + radio/select/checkbox with field_name 'question::radio|select|checkbox') per question of the current lesson. Shown only with course access.
radio-group: Radio list from specials.options used as a product filter/sort (options[].filter, filter_elements) or auto category list (is_auto_child_categories). Radio name is the element id, not a form field.
random-number: Number that moves a random step (up to specials.jumpNumber) from specials.startNumber toward endNumber on each visit, remembered per visitor (fake stock / viewer count).
rating-input: 5 stars: on a product page shows the product's average rating; elsewhere the visitor picks a score by hovering. specials.auto_hide_without_star hides it at 0. config.activeStarColor/inactiveStarColor.
rectangle-dataset: Plain styled box (same output/CSS as rectangle). Of its bindings only customer::… is wired (CustomerBinding); other bindings have no effect. Unused on real pages.
referral-code: Text field for a referral code, checked live against the site's referral rules (verify_referral_code) to apply a discount. Sits in a form; stored as referral_code. specials.label/placeholder.
retype-password: Confirm-password field (type=password) in a sign-up/change-password form; name = specials.field_name. specials.showHidePassword adds an eye toggle.
retype-phone-number: Confirm-phone field (type=tel) in a form; name = specials.field_name. Unused on real pages.
reward-point: Field to spend loyalty points at checkout: looks up the customer's points (by login or the form's phone) and applies the discount. Sits in a form. specials.auto_fill_reward_point.
search-droppable: Dropdown panel of an input-search (results/suggestions area). Sits only in input-search; children: text, grid-product, menu, rectangle… config.droppable_position, config.use_overlay.
search-form: Plain text input in a form (same output as input); name = specials.field_name. The form-builder's 'search' field.
slider-blog: Carousel of blog CATEGORIES (not posts): specials.showBlogs or the top-level blog categories; card overlay from a blog-overlay child. specials.slideMode. Unused on real pages.
slider-category: Carousel of product categories linking to each category page: specials.showCategories or all top-level categories. Sits in a section. specials.slideMode, config.sizeThumbnail.
slider-post: Carousel of blog posts of specials.category_id (numbers_posts_to_show). Card overlay = post-overlay child with specials.type 'post-overlay'. Sits in a section/container.
submenu: Dropdown list (<ul>) under a menu-item, opened on hover/click. Sits only in menu-item; children: menu, container, image, text, slider-product… config.position, specials.type.
swiper: Slide carousel; children: slide. specials.autoplay, autoplayDelay, paginate + paginateBar bullet|bar|fraction, direction, infinity, transitionMode, transitionTime.
switch: Toggle switch; its click event decides the effect: Toggle (show/hide its toggles targets), UseRewardPoint (spend points in order forms), AutoNextTrack (course autoplay). specials.defaultValue.
table: HTML table of a data grid (specials.datagrid_id): its visible columns as headers and its rows, formatted by column type (date, address, image…).
tags: Chip list from specials.options used as a product filter (options[].filter, filter_elements, selectionMode) or auto categories/keywords that filter or redirect. Often in menu-droppable or tabs.
tee-form: Personal-product-design form, rendered only on a product page when the Personal Product Design app is active and the product is a design product; filled client-side. No settings.
two-point-range: Dual-handle range slider specials.min..max; with specials.filter 'filter_price' it filters products by price (filter.v.price.gte/lte). specials.use_button_filter = apply on button.
user-point-log: Logged-in member's loyalty point history, loaded client-side and paged (specials.logPerPage, default 6; unit label specials.pointText). Often in tabs.
video-dataset: Course video player bound to bindings[0].target product::video_lesson (lesson from ?track_id) or product::video_file_download. Children: next-lesson-droppable, list-lesson-droppable.
warehouse: Store/branch picker: repeats its children per entry of specials.warehouses (bind texts with warehouse::…); click selects the branch and on a product page shows that branch's stock.
warehouse-dataset: Not rendered by the published page — don't use.
wishlist: Wishlist icon (specials.svg: SVG markup or image URL) with a saved-items count badge. No built-in navigation: add a click/link event to the wishlist page. Sits in header section/container.
